subject.title: Feature: Webchat / Control UI inline button support (buttons parameter, callback RPC, capabilities config)

question: Should WebChat inline buttons ship as shared `MessagePresentation` typed-action blocks over chat events/history with an authenticated `chat.callback` RPC, and should v1 add a WebChat/Control UI capability config toggle?
rationale: The first implementation defines public Gateway protocol, callback security, session binding, and a possible replacement for a retired WebChat config surface, which automation should not choose unilaterally.

options.title: Typed presentation plus RPC
options.body: Use shared `MessagePresentation` typed actions, add a scoped authenticated `chat.callback` RPC, and keep webhook routing out of v1.

options.title: Split contract from UI
options.body: Approve the schema/RPC/auth contract first and leave Control UI rendering and click state for a follow-up implementation issue.

options.title: Defer core WebChat interactivity
options.body: Keep WebChat text-only for now and route broader reactions, feedback, or rich interaction work through the larger WebUI interaction tracker or plugin API design.

recommendation.title: Typed presentation plus RPC
recommendation.body: Use shared `MessagePresentation` typed actions, add a scoped authenticated `chat.callback` RPC, and keep webhook routing out of v1.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-history connection across gateway protocol, WebChat docs, and Control UI chat rendering.
